title: Updating the query-length register
statement: For a state $s$ with fifteen natural-number registers, let its register vector list the values of $y,p,x,t,c,s,e,n,m,k,q,i,d,u,z$ in that order. Replacing coordinate $0$ of this vector by $v$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its query-length register $y$ by $v$.
